reviews.title: Always go Kingston RAM!
reviews.comment:
If you are a gamer or even just someone who wants to build or upgrade a PC with Quality and Performance parts, go with Kingston RAM. Their Fury, Hyper Fury and Fury Beast models are all about quality performance and last. Ive tried many other brands in the past since the 90's building my first PC's as a kid, but Kingston has lasted the longest. Most other brands like G.S. fail after a few years, but they are generally a good buy when you are on a budget and need to spend elsewhere.
I bought 32Gb (2x16Gb) and very happy. Motherboard can handle 64Gb, so maybe down the line ill cap it. But that means I have to modify my CPU Heatsink as its blocking a slot. But thats a different product issue, not here.
Kingston Fury Beast RAM: 5 of 5 stars!!!
reviews.author: NinjaNutjob

reviews.title: Problems are fixed!
reviews.comment: This RAM fixed all my issues when updating BIOS. For reference I’m using a b650 Gigabyte Aorus Elite AX with a G.skill flare x5 5600mhz ram set. Didn’t think ram would be the problem giving me so many problems trying to update to latest bios, but it was. This ram works superb in the latest bios F4b for my board and EXPO/XMP is running like a champ, as well as my PBO settings on my 7700x. I’m glad someone suggested trying a new ram lol

reviews.title: Great low profile DDR5 Ram
reviews.comment:
Amazon sent the wrong kit, so I didn't get to thoroughly test the 6000 MT/s kit. That said, the 5400 MT/s kit I received is functionally identical, and literally identical at base speeds.
The most important part that I can sincerely speak to is that this ram is very well made and low profile. You will struggle to find good quality, fast low-profile DDR5 RAM, so I will attempt to save you some time.
This kit, and all Kingston Fury Beast kits like it will be just under 35mm tall. Just call it 35mm.
G.Skil Flare X5 is the lowest profile I've used at about 33.5mm tall.
Corsair Vengeance DDR5 is just over 35mm, but not less than.
For all of these, RAM kits, most of your low-profile, top-draft air coolers will work.
I tested these kits with AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU and Gigabyte B650I Aorus Ultra & AsRock B650E PG-ITX motherboards. All kits worked at EXPO (if applicable) and XMP profiles with just one click. XMP has worked fine for me, even though I'm not using an Intel CPU/Chipset.
